prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy field-documentation photograph. The frame centers an original adult fictional woman and a constructed-material golem performing one task across a two-world fantasy portal threshold. Her visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. She stands in a rain-dark archive hall beside a complete stone threshold that reveals a snowy ruin. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Frame the scene at medium-wide eye level so one closed threshold boundary is anchored to the physical scene; the near side remains a complete readable local space; a materially different far-side space is visible through the same boundary. One clay-and-stone golem crosses the threshold plane. Show that one complete humanoid or creature body is assembled from nonliving material; the same clay stone earth or wood continues across torso limbs and joints; seams fitted blocks packed clay or bindings reveal deliberate construction. As one subject or object crosses the plane with coherent clipping and occlusion, posture contact shadow and displaced material show independent motion. Its hands carry the survey crate fully across; one handled load opened path or moved obstacle proves a completed task. At the plane, light dust reflection or distortion changes locally at the threshold. Keep both spaces, full golem anatomy, the woman's clearly adult face, and the crate legible in one balanced frame. Use cool snow daylight beyond the threshold and warm archive lamplight nearby, with restrained documentary contrast and realistic wet stone, clay, fabric, hair, and skin texture.
negative_en: broken facial features, fake-looking background, illustration look, excessive HDR, low resolution, 3D render look, distorted fingers, over-processed retouching, unrealistic hands, body distortion
